items.name: Pure Turmeric Powder
items.description: Our signature turmeric powder is sun-cured for 21 days and stone-ground in small lots to protect the volatile oils. Sourced from a single cooperative in Bengal, each batch is tested for curcumin content and screened for heavy metals. No fillers, no added colour, no irradiation.
items.usage: Use in cooking, golden milk (haldi doodh), face masks, and traditional remedies. A teaspoon a day is the household dose.

items.name: Organic Haldi Paste
items.description: A wet-ground paste of fresh turmeric rhizomes, preserved naturally with a touch of cold-pressed coconut oil. No preservatives, no citric acid, no water added beyond the rhizome's own. Sealed in amber glass to protect the actives from light.
items.usage: One teaspoon in warm milk, curries, marinades, or as a topical mask. Refrigerate after opening; use within 30 days.

items.name: Wellness Haldi (Curcumin+)
items.description: A high-curcumin turmeric powder blended with a trace of black pepper (piperine) to support absorption. Each batch is standardised to a minimum 6% curcumin. Intended as a functional food, not a medicine.
items.usage: Stir half a teaspoon into warm water or milk once a day, ideally with a fat source (ghee or milk).

items.name: Interior Premium Emulsion
items.description: A water-based interior emulsion with a soft velvet-matte finish. Engineered for uniform coverage, excellent scrub resistance, and a low-VOC formula that lets you move back in the same day. Available in 1,200+ shades.
items.usage: Living rooms, bedrooms, ceilings. Two coats over one primer coat. Coverage ~140 sq ft per litre per coat.

items.name: Exterior Weather Guard
items.description: A 100% acrylic exterior emulsion engineered for the Indian monsoon. Resists cracking, peeling, and algae growth, and carries an 8-year weatherability performance profile. UV-stable pigments keep colours true.
items.usage: Exterior walls, compound walls, balconies. Two coats over exterior primer. Coverage ~120 sq ft per litre per coat.

items.name: Natural Turmeric Paint
items.description: The signature that defines Gaurikrit. A lime-based, turmeric-infused natural paint with near-zero VOC, tinted only with plant and mineral pigments. Breathable, mould-resistant, and safe enough for a child's room the day it is painted. Carries GreenPro ecolabel.
items.usage: Bedrooms, nurseries, kitchens, and heritage interiors. Two coats; coverage ~100 sq ft per litre per coat.

items.name: Prime Wood Coating
items.description: A penetrating wood coating that nourishes the grain and builds a durable, water-repellent surface. Alkyd-resin base with plant-oil modifiers. Satin or gloss finish. No peeling — it wears in, not off.
items.usage: Doors, windows, furniture, exposed beams. Two to three coats. Coverage ~90 sq ft per litre per coat.

items.name: Bond Prime Sealer
items.description: A high-solids primer-sealer that bonds to fresh plaster, wood, and metal, and blocks water, smoke, and tannin stains. The foundation that makes every Gaurikrit topcoat last longer.
items.usage: Fresh plaster, repainting, stain cover. One coat under two topcoats. Coverage ~160 sq ft per litre per coat.
